mostWorthwhile.text: The connected well line made the separate parts feel like a functioning system, and the first cup gave it a human payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: The borehole and heating steps were straightforward and each presented only one combination, so there was little to figure out.

surprise.text: The first cup tasting of almost nothing was an evocative way to make clean water feel remarkable; the practical sequence itself was expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: drilling, heating, connecting, filtering and processing followed a clear physical sequence. The forced single options did limit decision-making.

continue.text: Yes, cautiously: the practical building and scientific setting interest me, though I would hope for more decisions than this chapter offered.
